baseline: Existing independently audited full benchmark outputs for the same split
candidate: Append one explicit JSON field contract to the existing TAT-QA system prompt; no parser or scorer relaxation
suffix: The JSON object must contain exactly the two keys answer and scale. Do not emit reasoning or any other keys, including unit, metric, period, or question_period. Use those attributes only to determine the answer and scale.
split_membership: All official_filtered_v1 TAT-QA inputs: development 222; test 1639, of which 1621 labeled
generation: Same historical_action adapter, vLLM BF16 base/LoRA, greedy temperature 0 and seed 0, original user evidence JSON unchanged
development_gate: Paired report-cluster EM difference CI95 lower > 0; F1 non-decrease; fewer output contract errors; request latency ratio <= 1.2
acceptance: Run test only after a passing frozen development decision. Apply the same gates; report all results without test-based prompt changes.
limits: Focused prompt-contract ablation, not model weight improvement. Parent test was previously exposed; this is not a new blind test. Existing FinQA predictions are unaffected and are not regenerated or attributed to this change.
